name: Neil
source:
Edgar's predecessor as the Guildmaster. Lucit's father. An easygoing man who gives the impression of unreliability, but his long years of experience as a Guildmaster impart him with wisdom and Edgar would do well to heed what advice he gives.

[Spoiler] After finding Lusit and Monos, Edgar quit adventuring and set up the O-Hitsuji guild. His advanced years mean he can no longer run the guild and the public house at once, especially with pressure from the Tora guild. He accepts Lusit's proposal to retire as Guild Master, but is always willing to share his knowledge and experience with Edgar.

His network of contacts is a wide one, including individuals who commission the guild for unusual requests like restaurant promotion... [/Spoiler]
